entries.scenario: Outcome planning, provider capability routing, approval boundary, safe Calendar event and Gmail draft verification
entries.environment: Tavall Cloud DEVELOPMENT; committed packaged Java Life Agent over loopback MCP; connected Google test identity
entries.serviceProvider: Google Calendar primary calendar and Gmail
entries.action: Java life_plan and life_provider_capabilities routed the travel-preparation outcome; Java life_request_action recorded Calendar and Gmail actions as WAITING_FOR_HUMAN. The connected host provider boundaries created a private disposable Calendar event and an unsent self-addressed Gmail draft.
entries.authoritativeVerification: google_calendar_read_event returned the event ID, private visibility, and exact time; gmail_read_email returned the message with DRAFT label and sent=false; gmail_list_drafts returned the matching draft. Both temporary provider records were moved/removed after capture.
